Findings.Observed: No documented weekly review of failed/unusual sign-ins

Findings.Title: Standing privileged group membership
Findings.Observed: Modelled privileged security group includes a disabled orphan account (leaver residual) — pattern carried from prior JML lab narrative

Findings.Title: Number of Global Administrators
Findings.Observed: More than two standing Global Admin equivalents modelled (break-glass + day-to-day overlap)

Findings.Title: Guest user inventory
Findings.Observed: Guests present without periodic access review

Findings.Title: MFA for privileged roles
Findings.Observed: Global Admin and Privileged Role Admin modelled without enforced phishing-resistant MFA on Free tier

Findings.Title: MFA for standard users
Findings.Observed: Per-user MFA not consistently enabled for all modelled cloud users

Findings.Title: Legacy authentication
Findings.Observed: Legacy auth protocols assumed still possible without CA block

RemediationTop5: Remove disabled accounts from privileged groups; verify leavers weekly.
Enforce MFA for all admins; prefer phishing-resistant methods where licensed.
Reduce standing Global Admins; use break-glass + time-boxed elevation (see JIT pilot).
Scan for external forwarding and inbox rules; alert on new rules.
Document Free-tier limits: no CA / ID Protection — do not claim those controls.
